frosted.condition: backdrop-filter supported without Chromium SVG refraction

highlight.background: radial-gradient(ellipse at var(--glass-light-x, 15%) var(--glass-light-y, 0%), var(--glass-highlight), transparent 48%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), transparent 38%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06))

optics.mapLifecycle: ResizeObserver schedules creation via requestAnimationFrame at initialization and resize; never rebuild on pointermove. Transparency preference changes clear or restore the map.
optics.pointerLifecycle: At most one pending requestAnimationFrame writes --glass-light-x/--glass-light-y; disabled for reduced motion or transparency.

ambient.lifecycle: Keep previous displayed cover until new Image.onload; ignore stale loads; missing/failed images clear cover to default.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Global animation/transition durations become 0.01ms with one animation iteration; pointer light stops; optics retain a static highlight; home arrival animation is omitted.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Clear refraction map, use solid glass/content backgrounds, disable backdrop-filter and optical gradients, hide ambient cover, stop pointer light.
accessibility.keyboard: Named fields, modal initial focus/Tab containment/return, focus-visible action affordances, keyboard progress seeking and queue removal.
accessibility.boundaries: Mocked API, public cover assets and silent WAV verification are not real account, listening or cloud-write acceptance.
accessibility.queueCurrentTrack: Current queue title uses var(--color-text); theme selected background identifies the current item. Other navigation and page tabs retain var(--color-accent-ink).

components.name: Primary playback action
components.description: 首页重点推荐的主要播放操作。
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--color-action-bg); color: #f8fafc; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-full); padding: 11px 22px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--color-action-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Toolbar theme action
components.description: 工具栏中的圆形轻底色操作。
components.css: .ds-theme { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-content); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-theme:hover { color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-theme:active { transform: scale(.98); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-theme { transition: none; } }

components.name: Desktop search
components.description: 顶部搜索的可聚焦胶囊。
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input aria-label="搜索音乐" placeholder="搜索音乐、歌手、歌单"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; width: min(520px, 100%); height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--surface-content); color: var(--color-text-secondary); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 0; outline: none; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; caret-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Labelled navigation
components.description: 保留中文标签，以主题浅底标识当前页。
components.html: 推荐音乐每日推荐
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 580; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms, transform 180ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-secondary-bg-transparent); color: var(--color-text); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-current { color: var(--color-accent-ink); background: var(--color-primary-bg); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition: none; } }

components.name: Page tabs
components.description: 页内横向标签的选中与默认状态。
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tab { border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-full); padding: 9px 18px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-secondary-bg-transparent); } .ds-tab.ds-selected { background: var(--color-primary-bg); color: var(--color-accent-ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-tab:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Track content container
components.description: 轻底色曲目容器；无独立折射。
components.css: .ds-track-list { background: var(--surface-content); border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px; } .ds-track { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-track span { color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-track:hover { background: var(--color-secondary-bg-transparent); } .ds-track:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass control material
components.description: 静态磨砂回退预览；运行时 SVG 折射由 GlassSurface 注入。
components.html: 共享播放器 · 控制层
components.css: .ds-glass { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 88px; padding: 12px 24px; color: var(--color-text); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-glass); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight); } .ds-optics { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--glass-solid); pointer-events: none; } @supports (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) { .ds-optics { background: var(--glass-tint); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(155%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) { .ds-optics { background: var(--glass-solid); backdrop-filter: none; } }

narrative.northStar: 封面是内容主体，液态玻璃是悬浮控制层
narrative.overview:
听潮面向桌面浏览器和 Electron。真实封面、曲目与歌词承担内容表达；导航、共享播放器和任务浮层采用通透、有边缘折射的控制材质。该实现是 Apple Liquid Glass 的网页近似，不代表 Apple 原生材质或官方 CSS 包。

银灰浅色与石墨深色提供稳定底色，用户原有强调色提供操作识别。默认背景保持冷调，登录后仅跟随当前播放曲目的封面；新图加载完成后才交叉淡入。已确认的设计参数为 DESIGN_VARIANCE 7、MOTION_INTENSITY 6、VISUAL_DENSITY 4。
keyCharacteristics: 真实封面主导内容，玻璃用于悬浮控制和任务浮层。
带文字的左侧导航、顶部搜索和账户、底部共享播放器形成稳定桌面框架。
系统字体、克制的文字层级、圆角封面与胶囊操作。
折射层与前景文字分离，并提供磨砂、实体及减少动态效果的降级。

rules.name: The Readable Accent Rule.
rules.body: 主要实色操作使用 action-bg 和 action-text；选中导航、页内标签和曲目列表的活动曲目使用 accent-ink；队列当前曲名采用正文色，以主题选中底色识别当前项。不要直接把所有主题色当作浅底小字或白字按钮的背景。

rules.name: The Clear Foreground Rule.
rules.body: 折射和模糊只作用于 GlassSurface 的独立光学层，文字与图标保持清晰。公共祖先不要添加会阻断后景采样的 opacity 或 filter。

dos: **Do** 让真实封面承担内容表达，把液态玻璃用于悬浮控制和任务浮层。
**Do** 使用最终语义变量和现有四个主题色，保留深浅外观及用户偏好。
**Do** 保持键盘焦点清晰，使焦点进入时也能看到卡片播放、曲目操作和队列移除入口。
**Do** 在减少透明度时关闭折射、隐藏封面氛围并使用实体表面，在减少动态效果时关闭追光、过渡和进场动画。
**Do** 将模拟接口、静音音频和渲染检查与真人登录、听音及云端写入验收分开报告。
donts: **Don't** 把网页近似称为 Apple 官方原生 Liquid Glass。
**Don't** 为每个内容卡片嵌套独立玻璃滤镜，或让前景文字参与折射。
**Don't** 重排首页后续推荐，或在个人中心恢复双侧栏。
**Don't** 把切页、打开详情或封面加载与自动播放绑定。
**Don't** 因视觉重设计修改账号、播放、缓存和持久化格式等既有业务契约。
